card.name: Punctuation before publisher or abbreviation
card.fires_on: Punctuation or link pieces right before a name or abbreviation: the colon after a US city in a citation, the bracket after 'polypeptide', and 'www' or '@' in web and email addresses.

modes.label: Citation colon
modes.description: Colon after a city and state in a reference, just before the publisher name.
modes.example: Boca Raton, FL<<:>> Chapman and Hall/CRC. ISBN

modes.label: Bracket after transporter name
modes.description: Opening parenthesis or bracket after 'organic anion transporting polypeptide', before OATP.

modes.label: Web or email address
modes.description: The 'www' or '@' piece inside a URL or email address.

card.plain: It fires on small punctuation marks that come just before a publisher name, a transporter abbreviation, or the rest of a web address.
